use_case: Dynamic ticket pricing: demand model sets prices per price level within floors and ceilings for reserved-seat events (11 own venues; opt-in module for 52 SL-1 clients)
business_owner: Vice President, Pricing and Revenue Management
vendor_or_model: In-house demand forecasting model (Cloud provider B) with the platform pricing service
data_categories: Sales velocity, inventory, days to event, page views, queue size, floor and ceiling settings; no patron-level inputs
consequential_decision_category: None (prices are the same for every buyer at a given time; not a consequential-decision category)
human_in_the_loop: Bounded automation: changes over 25% in 24 hours go to an analyst approval queue; owner can pause any event; accessible price levels come out of automation by 2026-10-15
applicable_laws: 16 CFR Part 464 (N71-R05); ADA 28 CFR 36.302(f)(3); FTC Act Section 5 (N71-R05); state laws on personalized pricing (counsel to confirm; not applicable while no personal data is used)
protected_characteristic_inputs: None (tested: test accounts with different histories and locations saw the same prices)
bias_testing_status: Local testing 2026-08: 2 accessible seating parity breaches in 40 events; channel parity met
monitoring: Daily parity check; weekly price-change review; quarterly fairness report
